task_title: Third-pass verification addendum for releng tick 10-22-25: gate, board, posture and publish-transport re-measured
task_criteria:
Third-pass verification addendum for releng tick code-factory-releng-2026-11-04-10-22-25 is appended to docs/audits/code-factory-releng-2026-11-04-posture.md and published on main, with exactly one appended audit event on the board.

Scope: this criterion grades the RECORD only. The release decision (no tag) and the pending posture rows CF-050, CF-120, CF-161, CF-163 and CF-190 are existing open work; do NOT require any of them to be fixed at this commit.

Executable legs the judge can re-run from the repo root at the graded commit:
1. bash tests/selftest.sh exits 0 and prints SELFTEST: PASS with 200 or more rows beginning "  PASS" (the rows beginning "  FAIL" are the battery's own negative fixtures).
2. bash scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK.
3. The file docs/audits/code-factory-releng-2026-11-04-posture.md contains a section heading "Verification addendum — third pass" naming this tick id, and it states: gate green at 3f9eb7b with 195 PASS rows; board 176 task rows and 356 events with 0 duplicate ids; zero published release tags; branch protection absent and rulesets 0; secret scanning and push protection enabled with 0 open alerts.
4. The addendum corrects the credential-shape probe: over HEAD, the PEM-header pattern (-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----) returns 0 hits, while the looser phrase pattern BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY matches exactly 2 self-referential hits, in .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl and in a published .gitreins/history/2026-11-04 bundle, so the addendum states the authored-source count is 0 and names the self-match.
5. The addendum records the SSH publish transport as INTERMITTENT rather than deterministically broken, with the counts it actually measured: 11 probes of git ls-remote git@github.com:coding-hermes/code-factory.git in two spellings produced 3 successes (rc=0), 2 auth refusals (rc=128, Permission denied (publickey)) and 6 hangs cut by timeout at 20s (rc=124), while the https remote answered every attempt; it states CF-190 is confirmed by the refusals and widened by the hangs, and that no new row was filed.
6. git diff --numstat against the parent commit shows the change adds one section to that one file plus exactly one appended line in .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl (an event with event_type audit and the tick id in its detail); .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl is untouched, so no board row was created or closed.
